candidates.change_summary: Remove the nonReentrant_ modifier from Put so it can be re-entered, changing balances observed after Put completes.
Set acc.unlockTime directly to _unlockTime instead of the maximum of _unlockTime and block.timestamp, so a past unlock time can be stored.
Credit 0 instead of msg.value so the deposited balance is not increased.
Delete the statement locked_ = false; at the end of nonReentrant_ so the lock is never released and any second Put call reverts.
Delete the statement require(!locked_); so reentrancy is no longer blocked, allowing nested Put calls to change state mid-execution.
